  • Data Ads: Plataforma de gestão de dados e conexão de publicidade direcionadas aos canais próprios que monetiza e impulsiona o crescimento do negócio. Soluções com uso de Apps e portais.

Main responsibilities

O que te espera no dia a dia?

  • Atuar como ponte entre os stakeholders internos (negócio, comercial, operações) e o time técnico, garantindo clareza e alinhamento sobre as prioridades do produto;
  • Participar ativamente da definição de visão, roadmap e backlog do produto, com foco em entregar valor contínuo ao negócio e aos usuários finais;
  • Realizar a gestão dos ritos ágeis (daily, planning, review, retro), mantendo o time alinhado, engajado e produtivo;
  • Ser responsável por elaborar e manter o backlog priorizado , escrevendo histórias claras, com critérios de aceite e bem definidas;
  • Elicitar necessidades e oportunidades com stakeholders e traduzi-las em requisitos de negócio e funcionalidades priorizadas;
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de desenvolvimento para garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos do produto e as expectativas do negócio;
  • Identificar riscos e dependências , buscando antecipar e propor soluções antes que se tornem problemas;
  • Acompanhar métricas e resultados das entregas, ajudando a refinar o produto com base em dados e feedbacks;
  • Contribuir ativamente na melhoria contínua dos processos do time , tanto em relação ao produto quanto à forma de trabalhar.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner, Analista de Projetos ou função equivalente em times de tecnologia ;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e participação ativa nos ritos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de produto/projetos (como Jira, Trello, Asana ou similares);
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação para interagir com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos ;
  • Conhecimento básico de redes, banco de dados e desenvolvimento de software , suficiente para dialogar com times técnicos e compreender soluções propostas;
  • Domínio do pacote Office (especialmente Excel/Sheets e PowerPoint/Slides para apresentações e acompanhamento).

Diferenciais que chamam nossa atenção:

  • Certificações em Scrum (CSPO, PSM I/II) ou gestão de projetos (PMI, PMP, Prince2);
  • Experiência anterior em PMOs ou áreas de gestão de portfólio/projetos ;
  • Participação ativa em times que aplicam práticas modernas de desenvolvimento ágil , como integração contínua, deploy automatizado, testes automatizados etc.;
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de software , seja como dev, QA ou tech analyst;
  • Experiência prática com Jira, Confluence ou similares ;
  • Conhecimento de plataformas cloud , especialmente AWS ;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico e com olhar para construção de produtos digitais com foco no usuário.

Additional information

E aí, curtiu? Temos mais!

Na Akross oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho descontraído , muito aprendizado , diversão com responsabilidade, possibilidade de atuar com tecnologia de ponta e oportunidade de desenvolvimento . Valorizamos a diversidade e trabalhamos para proporcionar um ambiente acolhedor para todos e todas.

Quais são os nossos benefícios?

  • Trabalho Híbrido: Desfrute da liberdade de trabalhar de casa ou do escritório, garantindo flexibilidade e conforto em seu ambiente de trabalho.
  • Auxílio Home Office: Receba apoio financeiro para ajudar na conta de luz e/ou internet;
  • Cuidado Integral com a Saúde: Tenha acesso a planos abrangentes de assistência médica e odontológica do Bradesco Seguros , garantindo tranquilidade e cuidado para você e sua família.
  • Benefício Flexível: Desfrute de um cartão de benefícios flexível da Swile que coloca você no controle, com R$ 1.000 por mês para usar em vale-alimentação e refeição.
  • Viva Mais e Melhor: Acesse a Wellhub (antiga gympass) , uma plataforma que oferece uma rede de parceiros para atividades físicas e de saúde, ajudando você a manter um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.
  • Mente Equilibrada, Vida Melhor: Utilize a plataforma Vittude para cuidar da sua saúde mental, com orientação psicológica online acessível;
  • Crescimento Profissional Contínuo: Estimulamos seu desenvolvimento oferecendo incentivos para cursos, certificações e participação em eventos relevantes, ajudando você a alcançar seus objetivos de carreira.
  • Equilíbrio Familiar: Desfrute de uma licença paternidade estendida de 20 dias, licença maternidade de 180 dias e auxílio creche/babá , demonstrando nosso compromisso em apoiar você em todas as fases da vida.
  • Celebre seu Dia Especial: Tire um dia de folga no seu aniversário para celebrar e recarregar as energias.
  • Parceria com o Sesc : benefícios exclusivos para você e sua família com acesso a serviços de saúde, cultura, lazer, esportes e muito mais . Aproveite tudo o que o Sesc oferece para o seu bem-estar!
  • Programa Indique um Amigo: Receba voucher ao indicar uma pessoa para trabalhar com a gente;
  • Reconhecimento Financeiro: Além disso, temos a possibilidade de bônus anual (PLR) como reconhecimento pelo seu empenho e contribuição de acordo com as regras internas da empresa.

Se você gosta de inovar e está sempre buscando conhecimento, somos um match perfeito!

title: Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Goal of function: We are seeking a Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d) to lead and innovate Care Enablement Medical Advocacy strategies to improve external HCP stakeholder engagement and knowledge development, ultimately creating advocacy for innovative therapies. The position involves developing and organizing customized therapy programs such as educational round tables, symposia and reference center programs for targeted education and advocacy, creating opportunities to meaningfully educate and impact the practice of participants. It requires collaboration across all functions of the business units and regions (Marketing, Sales, Application, Compliance, and Medical Affairs) to develop an agile program strategy aligned with business priorities and strategic imperatives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation and execution of a strategic medical marketing and advocacy plan targeting external HCPs, aligned with business goals and addressing gaps, ensuring a consistent risk-based approach. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to build strong relationships with internal and external speakers to create impactful educational programs. Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. Establish and support reference centers of excellence as hubs for peer-to-peer learning and clinical demonstration
  • Oversee planning, contracting, and execution of impactful commercial advocacy activities like symposia, workshops, and conferences. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality events within medical and legal compliance frameworks
  • Lead the creation of targeted therapy content of the programs and events for diverse external audiences ensuring compliance with regulations and accreditation standards. Collaborate with KOLs on timely, creative promotion using marketing and social media platforms
  • Establish a global approval matrix for activities to ensure education programs comply with regulations and standards. Monitor and implement emerging regulatory trends
  • Lead a small team, ensure budget transparency, and foster a high-performance, collaborative culture
  • Assess educational program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement

Profile

  • Ideally Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Medicine. Advanced qualifications such as a PhD, Doctorate, MBA, or a marketing degree are considered a plus. Candidates with strong relevant experience may also be considered from other academic backgrounds
  • Min of 5-7 years of experience with advanced degree (alternatively min. of 10-15 years of experience with Master’s degree) in medical marketing, HCP education, or advocacy development within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry
  • Fluent in English, additional language skills (e.g., Dutch, German, Spanish) are a plus
  • Proven track record of building and managing KOL networks and educational initiatives
  • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks in medical communications
  • Leads with vision and impact, demonstrating excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills while navigating complexity, ensuring accountability, and driving continuous improvement to achieve strategic goals
  • Willingness to travel regionally/nationally as needed

Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter on

in which field you are an expert (m/f/d) and how much experience you have - for your professional career.

A Future with meaning

  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world

 Billing Administrator is responsible for preparing, tracking, and maintaining invoices and backup documentation related to sponsored research projects. Reporting to the Billing and Reporting Manager, the Billing Administrator ensures timely and accurate billing of grants and contracts in accordance with sponsor requirements and federal regulations. This role supports post-award financial processes by organizing documentation, assisting with invoice reconciliations, and maintaining the central billing repository.

The Billing Administrator collaborates closely with post-award analysts, accountants, and department administrators to manage invoice processing and documentation. The position supports the University’s research financial compliance and contributes to efficient grant billing operations.

title: Maritime Sales Support Coordinator
description:
Your Mission

As a Sales Support Coordinator, you will support the Americas maritime sales team in achieving revenue and acquisition targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

The Inside Sales Coordinator reports to the Vice President of Sales, Americas. You will primarily support the Brazil-based sales team and occasionally assist the North American team.

Main Tasks

  • Support Key Account Managers with preparing sales proposals.
  • Quote and process less complex customer inquiries, such as for mobile satellite services (MSS).
  • Facilitate customer requests to the relevant departments for execution.
  • Act as a secondary contact for customers in the absence of the Key Account Manager.
  • Prepare, submit, and follow up on sales documentation, including contracts, change orders, vessel transfers, customer questionnaires, and portal management.
  • Assist customers with contract registration and manage onboarding processes.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

  • Successful experience in B2B sales support or inside sales environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish fluency is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Dynamics CRM.
  • Experience in the maritime industry is preferred but not essential. Knowledge of satellite, network/IP technologies, or IT/telecommunications is advantageous.

Attitude & Interpersonal Skills

  • Structured approach to customer service and task management.
  • High commitment, energy, and enthusiasm for working with customers and internal teams.
  • Ability to take initiative and work independently.
  • Active sharing of information and knowledge within the organization.
  • Effective engagement with colleagues from diverse cultures and time zones.
  • Excellent listening and communication skills to understand customer needs.
  • Sense of urgency to support a 24/7 global customer base.

We Offer

  • Be part of a market-leading success story eager to further shape the industry.
  • Opportunity to gain expertise in sectors where Marlink operates.
  • Flexible hybrid work model with home office options.
  • Access to Marlink Training Academy for professional and personal development.

Sobre o Grupo Marlink

Marlink é líder de mercado nos setores de navegação, energia, mineração, humanitário e governamental. Projetamos, construímos e gerenciamos redes de tecnologia agnósticas, unificando serviços via satélite, terrestres e digitais em soluções confiáveis.

Nosso portfólio evoluiu para além da conectividade, oferecendo serviços totalmente gerenciados, incluindo redes, cibersegurança, TI e IoT. Entregamos possibilidades em qualquer lugar.

À medida que a Marlink continua a crescer, buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Suporte de Vendas para apoiar nossa equipe comercial na região das Américas, com foco principal na América Latina.

Sua Missão

Como Coordenador(a) de Suporte de Vendas, você apoiará a equipe de vendas marítimas das Américas para atingir metas de receita e aquisição, mantendo altos níveis de satisfação do cliente.

O Coordenador de Vendas Internas reporta-se ao Vice-Presidente de Vendas das Américas. Você dará suporte principalmente à equipe no Brasil, e ocasionalmente à equipe na América do Norte.

Principais Atividades

  • Apoiar os Gerentes de Contas-Chave na preparação de propostas comerciais.
  • Responder e processar solicitações de clientes menos complexas, como serviços móveis via satélite (MSS).
  • Encaminhar solicitações aos departamentos responsáveis para execução.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato secundário na ausência do Gerente de Contas-Chave.
  • Preparar, enviar e acompanhar documentação de vendas, contratos, ordens de alteração, transferências de embarcações, questionários de qualificação e portais.
  • Auxiliar no registro de contratos e gerenciar o onboarding de clientes.

Qualificações e Competências Profissionais

  • Experiência bem-sucedida em suporte de vendas B2B ou vendas internas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação em português e inglês; espanhol é desejável.
  • Familiaridade com aplicativos Microsoft, como PowerPoint, Word, Excel e Dynamics CRM.
  • Experiência na indústria marítima é preferencial, conhecimentos em tecnologias via satélite, redes/IP, TI/telecomunicações são diferenciais.

Atitude e Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Abordagem estruturada ao atendimento ao cliente e gestão de tarefas.
  • Comprometimento, energia e entusiasmo no trabalho com clientes e equipes internas.
  • Iniciativa e autonomia no trabalho.
  • Compartilhamento ativo de informações e conhecimentos.
  • Capacidade de envolver-se com colegas de diferentes culturas e fusos horários.
  • Ótimas habilidades de comunicação e escuta ativa.
  • Senso de urgência para dar suporte a uma base de clientes global 24/7.

Oferecemos

  • Participar de uma história de sucesso de liderança de mercado, com desejo de moldar o setor.
  • Oportunidade de adquirir expertise nos setores de atuação da Marlink.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido flexível com opção de home office.
  • Treinamento profissional e pessoal na Marlink Training Academy.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Function
Develops data-oriented systems to meet an organization’s or research team’s needs. Duties include developing systems, procedures and policies for data management in an organization, assisting colleagues in performing data-related tasks.
Supervisory Accountability
May be responsible for providing limited supervision for one or more functions within a department.
Nature And Scope
Assist organizations in utilizing big data to gain business intelligence and insights into other user’s experiences and behaviors. Monitor data systems to ensure that they are organized, secure, and accessible.
Work independently or as part of a team, to manage and safeguard data.
Principal Accountabilities
  • Designing, developing, and modifying data infrastructure to accelerate the processes of data analysis and reporting.
  • Reviewing presentations, manuscripts, graphs, and tables to ensure accuracy and quality.
  • Developing standards of operation when handling and archiving data.
  • Maintaining data management plans and instructions for operating complex business systems.
  • Overseeing the integration of new technologies and initiatives into data standards and structures.
  • Evaluating the design, selection, and implementation of database changes by comparing them with business requirements and design documents.
  • Assessing system performance and making recommendations for hardware, software, and data storage improvements.
  • Ensuring data and information security by integrating and upholding digital security systems.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.
Core Competencies And Qualifications
  • Must be familiar with database design and systems, database technology, and logical data analysis.
  • Ability to analyze, interpret, and organize large amounts of data.
  • Excellent communication skills to translate complex problems using non-technical terms.
  • In-depth understanding of modern database and information technologies.
  • Excellent math, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to work towards meeting multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to compile and organize findings and data retrieved before presenting it to management.
  • Thorough understanding of management and data administration duties such as collection, analysis, and distribution.
Minimum Requirements
A bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field. Candidates with a bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, or other science-related field are likely to possess the excellent math and analytical skills necessary to succeed in the role. 3-5 years of experience preferred.
Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not to be construed as a contract for employment.

description:
Gerente de Manutenção Naval | Onshore | Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Oceanica Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Nós somos amantes do oceano. Somos uma empresa brasileira que há mais de 45 anos desenvolve soluções submarinas para o mercado de energia offshore, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos oceanos. Se você compartilha essa paixão pelo mar e é comprometido com a proteção do meio ambiente, seu lugar é aqui na Oceânica. Venha fazer parte da nossa família!

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar plano de manutenção (preventiva e corretiva) das embarcações, instalações e seus equipamentos.
  • Garantir a execução das rotinas de manutenção da embarcação (CHEMAQ / SUBCHEMAQ / ELETRICISTA) visando o cumprimento do plano de manutenção dos equipamentos da embarcação nas suas periodicidades requeridas e atualização.
  • Planejar as intervenções de manutenção nas embarcações de forma a realizá-las dentro dos prazos pré-estabelecidos e custos otimizados.
  • Assegurar os registros no software de gerenciamento da manutenção da embarcação pela equipe CHEMAQ / ELETRICISTA / SUB CHEMAQ.
  • Garantir o controle de estoque estratégico em razão de elevados prazos de fornecimento e sobretudo daqueles que podem levar à suspensão da operação da embarcação.
  • Assegurar a disponibilidade de equipamentos sobressalentes nas embarcações evitando paralisação das atividades planejadas com a consequente necessidade de deslocamento do barco para terra para tratamento da anomalia.
  • Participar e responder perante o cliente aos questionamentos decorrentes das auditorias do PEOTRAM no que concerne aos equipamentos da embarcação.
  • Participação nos processos de investigação de incidentes e acidentes motivados por mau funcionamento de equipamentos da embarcação.
  • Liderar e gerenciar a seleção de tripulantes de máquinas das embarcações: CHEMAQ / SUB CHEMAQ / ELETRICISTA / MARINHEIRO DE MÁQUINAS.
  • Liderar e gerenciar o treinamento e avaliação de tripulantes - máquinas (CHEMAQ / SUB CHEMAQ / MARINHEIRO DE MÁQUINAS / ELETRICISTA), garantindo que todos estejam devidamente treinados e equipados para realizar suas tarefas.
  • Elaborar e conduzir workshops internos de treinamentos / uniformização de procedimentos / troca de experiências operacionais vivenciadas pelas equipes de máquinas das embarcações.
  • Representar a empresa nos seminários e workshops promovidos pela PB referentes a falhas de equipamentos que resultem em incidentes ou acidentes nas embarcações.
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de uma cultura e clima organizacional alinhados às estratégias de negócios e características culturais, por meio da disseminação da missão e valores da empresa e liderando programas e iniciativas que suportem os resultados esperados.
  • Garantir o aprimoramento tecnológico de produtos e processos, de forma a assegurar o adequado atendimento das necessidades dos clientes.
  • Manter e incrementar, continuamente a formação técnica e os níveis de motivação / integração de sua equipe, conscientizando-a por meio de feedbacks e orientações da necessidade de um efetivo comprometimento em relação a objetivos, princípios de qualidade, meio ambiente e à melhoria contínua dos resultados.

description:
Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)

Experiência Mínimo 6 anos

Context & Environment

O titular do cargo está localizado no escritório da TEEPBR no Rio de Janeiro. A posição exige comunicação transversal e coordenação com outras entidades da TEEPBR e do Head Quarter, especialmente Gestão de Ativos Não Operados, Ativos Operados, Finanças, Departamentos Técnicos e de Economia.

Atividades

O colaborador deve realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios do One Maestro, visando resguardar a integridade das pessoas, do meio ambiente e dos ativos e reputação da empresa.

HSE (demonstrar exemplaridade, promover cultura de HSE):

  • Garantir conformidade com a política de HSE da TotalEnergies e regulamentos brasileiros/internacionais.
  • Contribuir com a melhoria contínua de desempenho em HSE.

Função principal: Coordenar e Facilitar os Engenheiros de Desenvolvimento dos Ativos OA/ObO nos seus objetivos relacionados a exercícios de Orçamento/PdC e preparação de Cartões de Custos para ARRE/LTP e estudos econômicos pontuais. Essa função transversal no departamento LTP & ECO deve permitir homogeneidade entre os diferentes processos e ativos de desenvolvimento.

  • Liderar discussões, acordos e documentação sobre as diversas premissas de negócio que impactam os resultados dos exercícios corporativos estratégicos, como: custos de offloading, volumes e preços de gás, diferenciais de óleo, inflação, câmbio, hipóteses regulatórias.
  • Apoiar os especialistas DEV ObO no acompanhamento de seus Ativos, envolvendo contatos regulares com os departamentos técnicos da subsidiária e com o GPI (Geociências, Operações de Campo, D&W e NP&I).
  • Coordenar os insumos fornecidos pelos especialistas DEV ObO durante a preparação de LTP, ARRE e exercícios orçamentários para os diferentes Ativos, incluindo preparação de apresentações gerenciais, planilhas mestres e bancos de dados.
  • Ser responsável pela preparação de comparativos sintéticos dos diferentes exercícios (LTP, Orçamento, PdCs, ARRE/Reservas) e comitês de JV (TCM, OCM) visando rastrear hipóteses (planejamento, perímetro, suposições econômicas ou financeiras).
  • Apoiar os especialistas DEV ObO no acompanhamento, com os controladores de custos, da evolução do consumo do orçamento dos Ativos ObO e do acompanhamento do Programa de Trabalho e Orçamento anual de cada Ativo.

Planejamento Integrado

  • Fazer interface com a equipe de Planejamento Integrado da Afiliada para garantir alinhamento das informações com as premissas do LTP.
  • Manter o histórico dos planejamentos operacionais (perfuração, instalação, projetos) com justificativas e explicações subjacentes.

Estudos e Projetos

  • Assumir estudos ou análises específicas sobre temas pontuais.
  • Participar de estudos transversais que impactem diversos Ativos.
  • Apoiar os especialistas DEV ObO no acompanhamento dos Estudos e Projetos e auxiliá-los durante os processos de validação reunindo informações, preparando apresentações e notas sintéticas.

Documentação e Relatórios

  • Liderar a Gestão da Informação do exercício de Planejamento de Longo Prazo: estruturar documentação, criar processo para arquivamento sistemático de todos os documentos (apresentações, MoM, hipóteses, cartões de custos, orçamentos).
  • Construir banco de dados com informações validadas sobre os ativos (mapas, poços, perfis, fichas dos ativos).
  • Garantir que os bancos de dados LTP (Shuttle, CFR-Pro, ENV etc.) estejam atualizados e que os prazos definidos pelo HQ para carga de dados sejam cumpridos.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o acompanhamento do Desenvolvimento dos Ativos.
  • Gerar informações técnicas validadas para o exercício de Planejamento de Longo Prazo, principalmente sobre Produção, Capex e Opex.
  • Garantir um banco de dados técnico atualizado e completo das atividades do LTP e de outros exercícios estratégicos corporativos.

Perfil do Candidato

  • Formação : Graduação em Engenharia ou equivalente em Petróleo, Mecânica, Produção, Projetos etc.
  • Experiência profissional : Mínimo de 5 anos na indústria de óleo e gás com primeiro contato com perfuração, operações de campo ou projetos durante estágio ou similar.
  • Competências técnicas : Integração de valores HSE, interesse pelo setor de O&G. Excelente domínio de ferramentas de comunicação e banco de dados. Autonomia na organização do trabalho, bem organizado, rigoroso para produzir resultados/informações validadas, sensibilidade à inovação.
  • Competências comportamentais : Boa comunicação, interesse por ambiente multicultural e networking. Capacidade de adaptação e gestão de tarefas diversas em diferentes configurações. Adaptável e flexível sob pressão e prazos curtos.
  • Outras competências : Fluente em inglês.

  • UX sensibility in web-products
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • WordPress CMS experience
  • Team player

What we offer

With our talented employees at the forefront we want to conquer the sports media world and become the leading digital sports media group. We want to bring a unique lens to the world of sports, mixing premium content, proprietary tools, and in-depth analysis to make sports fans with something at stake, smarter about betting. For people that love sports, working at Better Collective is an opportunity to work on something you are passionate about and make work purposeful and fun. The position is for the Senior Manager, Telecom at FIFA Women’s World Cup . FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.
  • Actively participate in the scope definition, procurement liaison, supplier selection and onboarding of Telecom and Network suppliers
  • Lead the management of Telecom infrastructure build and implementation, ensuring timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and decommissioning of venues.
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient provision of Telecom services for FIFA Offices, Tournaments and Events at select FIFA Events.
  • Track the progress of Telecom Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Telecom Infrastructure projects and operations, according to IT governance and keep counterpart aligned.
  • Manage an international Team of Telecom Experts/Managers including remote personnel in other countries/time zones.
  • Liaise with and/or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to the delivery and support of Telecom Infrastructure are communicated to and well understood by all parties.
  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more

title: Product Owner Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A pessoa Product Owner será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantir alinhamento com a visão estratégica da empresa e mapear a jornada do cliente. Atuará como ponte entre stakeholders e o time de desenvolvimento, acompanhando sprints, validando entregas e tomando decisões ágeis para maximizar o valor entregue ao usuário.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, criando e mantendo uma lista clara e priorizada de funcionalidades, melhorias e correções que precisam ser desenvolvidas. A priorização deverá ser feita com base em critérios como valor de negócio, impacto no cliente, urgência e complexidade técnica.
  • Detalhar requisitos e funcionalidades sob a forma de histórias de usuário (user stories), fornecendo critérios de aceitação claros e compreensíveis para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir que o backlog esteja sempre refinado, constantemente atualizado com feedbacks do cliente e equipe, removendo itens obsoletos ou não mais relevantes.
  • Definir a visão do produto, articulada com as metas estratégicas da empresa e as necessidades do mercado.
  • Mapear a jornada do cliente, entendendo profundamente quem são os usuários, seus problemas e como o produto pode atender a essas necessidades ao longo da sua jornada.
  • Definir as entregas e marcos (milestones) ao longo do tempo, garantindo que haja uma estratégia clara de desenvolvimento e evolução do produto.
  • Negociar e alinhar as expectativas dos stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes: agir como o ponto central de comunicação entre os times técnicos, stakeholders e usuários, evitando mal-entendidos e desentendimentos.
  • Garantir que os objetivos das sprints sejam cumpridos, fornecendo feedback constante e eliminando possíveis impedimentos.
  • Avaliar cada incremento do produto desenvolvido pelo time, verificando se os critérios de aceitação foram cumpridos e se a entrega atende às expectativas do cliente e do mercado.
  • Ser ágil ao tomar decisões, tanto no que diz respeito a novas funcionalidades quanto à manutenção do escopo e à priorização de correções.
  • Balancear o que é tecnicamente possível com o que é economicamente viável, sempre levando em consideração o valor que será entregue ao usuário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com gestão de backlog, priorização de funcionalidades e ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ágeis: Scrum, Kanban e outras metodologias ágeis.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Experiência em criação de histórias de usuário bem definidas, com critérios de aceitação claros e objetivos.
  • Experiência com negociação de prazos, funcionalidades e recursos, equilibrando as demandas do negócio com as limitações técnicas.

title: Brazil RINA Consulting HSE Senior Advisor
description:
Overview

Brazil RINA Consulting HSE Senior Advisor role at RINA in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Senior Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role ensures the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures and protocols, for the security of Company assets, projects and business travels.

Key Accountabilities

  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay updated on local, state, and federal health, safety, and environmental regulations. Ensure that the organization complies with all relevant laws and standards.
  • Risk Assessment and Management: Conduct risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate risks and prevent accidents or incidents.
  • HSE Policies and Procedures: Develop, implement, and enforce HSE policies and procedures. Communicate these policies to employees and ensure understanding and adherence.
  • Training and Education: Develop and deliver HSE training programs for employees at all levels. Create educational materials and promote awareness of health and safety issues.
  • Incident Investigation: Lead investigations into accidents, incidents, or near-misses to determine root causes. Implement corrective actions to prevent similar occurrences in the future.
  • Emergency Response Planning: Develop and maintain emergency response plans. Organize and conduct drills and training exercises to prepare employees for emergencies.
  • Inspections and Audits: Conduct regular inspections and audits to identify potential hazards and areas of non-compliance. Work with other departments to address and rectify identified issues.
  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement. Prepare reports on HSE performance for management and regulatory authorities.
  • Collaboration with Other Departments: Collaborate with departments such as operations, engineering, and human resources to integrate HSE considerations into daily activities. Participate in project planning to ensure HSE requirements are met.
  • Environmental Management: Manage environmental programs, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. Implement strategies to reduce the organization's environmental impact.
  • Communication: Communicate regularly with employees, management, and external stakeholders about HSE issues. Foster a culture of safety and environmental responsibility within the organization.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures. Stay informed about industry best practices and technological advancements.
  • Documentation and Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities. Ensure documentation is available for regulatory inspections and audits.
  • Training and Development: Stay current with advancements in HSE practices through professional development. Pursue relevant certifications and attend training programs as needed.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare or Environmental Science

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in health, safety, and environmental roles, especially in oil and gas industry, infrastructure construction. This may include experience in conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing HSE programs in compliance with all applicable Brasilian laws.
  • It is required the qualification of Occupational Safety Technician in accordance with Brazilian legislation Regulatory Standard NR4 of the Ministry of Labour and Employement. Are also required the Lead Auditor ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certificates.
  • Relevant certifications can enhance a candidate's profile. Common certifications include:
  • Lead Auditor ISO 9001
  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
  • Occupational Health and Safety Technician (OHST)
  • Associate Safety Professional (ASP)
  • NEBOSH (National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health) certificate
  • OSHA 30-Hour or 40-Hour General Industry Certification
  • Strong understanding of Brasilian local, state, and federal health, safety, and environmental regulations applicable to engineering consulting companies working in oil and gas industry onshore and offshore, construction of infrastructures, marine consultancy.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for effectively conveying HSE policies, procedures, and issues to employees, management, and regulatory bodies, in brasilian and in english languages.
  • Collaboration skills to work effectively with other departments and teams in integrating HSE considerations into daily operations.
  • Expertise in leading risk assessments, audits, and incident investigations, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement HSE strategies, programs, and policies to ensure a proactive safety culture.

Competencies

  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS - Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources and constraint

What You'll Do


As a Software Developer in Test at BCG X, you will play a pivotal role in improving our software development lifecycle, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, robust software solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of Concepts/Minimum Viable Products to long term cases.

  • Work closely with development and product teams to identify and mitigate risks before software release

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to validate software functionalities, performance, and reliability

  • Collaborate on software design reviews to ensure testability and best practices are incorporated early in the development process

  • Analyze test results, identify issues, and work with development teams to resolve them promptly

  • Stay abreast of the latest testing technologies and methodologies to continuously improve testing strategies and efficiency


Must-Have Technical Skills



  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, JavaScript, and familiarity with Unix/Linux environments.

  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman).

  • Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and the ability to write and debug SQL queries.


Job Requirements



  • Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

A tecnologia no BTG vem contribuindo com as grandes transformações do banco. Para isso, investimos em tudo que há de mais novo no mercado.   • Criação e automação de processos relacionados a gestão de capital e risco regulatório (Mercado, Crédito e Liquidez) dentro de sistema proprietário do banco;
  • Aprenderá e contribuirá para uma solução criada totalmente in-house no BTG sendo incentivado a entender nos detalhes cada tópico e produto que abordarmos junto com os usuários;
  • Relacionamento próximo com as áreas de negócio e outras equipes de IT do Grupo BTG Pactual;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das plataformas criando e evoluindo processos de deploy;

Esperamos De Você

  • Formação superior completa preferencialmente em engenharia, ciências da computação, ciências exatas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Base sólida em matemática e programação, interesse no mercado financeiro (ex: funcionamento dos mercados, produtos, precificação e riscos);

title: Senior Data Architect – Data & AI
description:
Company Overview

Blue Orange Digital is a cloud-based data transformation and predictive analytics development firm with offices in NYC and Washington, DC. From startups to Fortune 500s, we help companies make sense of their business challenges by applying modern data analytics techniques, visualizations, and AI/ML. Founded by engineers, we love passionate technologists and data analysts. Our startup DNA means everyone on the team makes a direct contribution to the growth of the company.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Overview

We are seeking a Databricks Data Architect who can own Lakehouse design and governance and represent that vision in front of clients. You’ll spend most of your time embedded with delivery squads—modeling data, tuning clusters, and enforcing standards—but you’ll also step into discovery workshops, help scope solutions, and support pre-sales conversations when deep architectural insight is needed.

Responsibilities

  • Client Engagement & Solution Development
    • Act as the primary technical liaison during key engagements—translating business goals into architecture that both sides understand.
    • Lead discovery workshops and roadmap sessions to surface requirements, constraints, and success metrics, then map them to scalable Databricks patterns.
    • Partner with account & sales teams to shape estimates, reference architectures, and bill-of-materials for proposals and SOWs.
    • Provide architecture-level answers for RFPs/RFIs and join pitch calls when deep Databricks credibility is essential.
    • Mentor client technical leads during early project phases to ensure knowledge transfer and long-term success.
  • Lakehouse Architecture & Design
    • Design logical/physical models, storage layers, and streaming/CDC patterns with Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.
    • Architect multi-cloud Databricks solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) covering ETL/ELT, structured streaming, and governance zones.
  • Governance & Security
    • Define catalog/permission models, retention policies, and lineage artifacts to meet HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, and similar frameworks.
    • Implement row-/column-level security, tokenization, and end-to-end audit logging.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization
    • Tune cluster sizing, Photon/SQL Warehouse configs, Z-Ordering, and auto-compaction to hit SLA and cost targets.
    • Instrument dashboards for query latency, job runtimes, and spend.
    • Lead design reviews, pair with engineers on PySpark/Scala, and sign off on pull requests before production.
    • Publish best-practice templates, Terraform workspace bootstraps, and CI/CD guidelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with Platform Ops, Security, Analytics, and Product teams to translate requirements into production-ready data solutions.
    • Host lunch-and-learns and brown-bag demos to level-up Databricks skill sets across Blue Orange.

Requirements

  • 5–7 years building cloud data platforms; 3+ years hands-on with Databricks.
  • Deep expertise in Delta Lake ACID, Unity Catalog, and Spark performance tuning.
  • Proven experience architecting Lakehouse or Cloud DW solutions on two or more major clouds.
  • Strong SQL + PySpark/Scala; working knowledge of dbt, Airflow, or similar orchestrators.
  • Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification (or ability to earn in 90 days).
  • Excellent communication skills for client workshops, documentation, and mentoring.
  • Ability to engage with and communicate effectively with clients at all levels, developing technical solutions that solve their challenges and/or advance their interests.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms; adept at engaging and influencing senior management and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, particularly adept at conveying complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Self-directed and motivated with a results-driven approach, capable of achieving deliveries and outcomes independently with limited external direction.
  • Eager to learn and adapt in a rapidly evolving tech landscape.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required to meet clients and attend industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a Databricks Champion within your organization.
  • Experience migrating legacy Hadoop/Snowflake/Redshift to Lakehouse.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Feature Store, and Databricks Model Serving.
  • DataOps/CI-CD for notebooks and IaC (Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Domain depth in one of our focus verticals (FinTech, Sports Analytics, Manufacturing, etc.).
  • Experience with transactional data systems and stacks, such as Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, as well as microservices, message queues, actor-models, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Experience consulting in Retail/CPG; Manufacturing; Travel & Hospitality.
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Oracle, Sage, Workday, etc.
  • Engineering certifications in Databricks (beyond pro), Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, and related tools.
  • Experience serving as a consultative liaison between clients and technical teams. Able to engage with senior-level stakeholders to understand their business challenges and articulate clear, compelling technical solutions aligned with their strategic goals.
  • Self-starter with proven abilities leading complex client engagement deliveries, often with ambiguity and little direction.
  • Master’s, MBA, or other advanced degree a plus.

Salary: USD$7,524 - $10,032.00 (monthly salary range DOE)

Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects.

Blue Orange Digital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Lieutenant
description:
Overview


Join to apply for the Lieutenant role at Inside Higher Ed .


The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.


At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.



Benefits



  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture



Join Howard University and thrive with us!



Basic Function


As Shift Supervisor the purpose of this position is to assist in maintaining a safe and secure campus and hospital environment by providing direct supervision and coordination over the daily activity of the security personnel, in keeping with established goals and objectives of the Howard University Campus Police Department.



Responsibilities



  • Responsible for managing the shift operations, training and overseeing patrol activities; directing traffic, controlling crowds, security facilities and training.

  • In the absence of higher ranking command officer the Lieutenant assumes supervisory responsibility for all operations during an assigned shift or shift function. Ensures that all shift personnel are aware of and adhere to policy and procedures.

  • Provides training and instructions to subordinates to ensure that responsibilities are performed completely and efficiently, while maintaining the Law Enforcement Code of Ethics.

  • Interprets and disseminates policies, procedures and directives promulgated by the Department and the Federal and municipal Governments.

  • Prepares and reviews all administrative reports of subordinates which include recommendations for awards, disciplinary actions, investigations, records and any other written correspondence for content and accuracy.

  • Manages vehicle operations to ensure that vehicles are utilized for official business.

  • Inspects security personnel for duty and assigns personnel to critical areas, issues equipment and ensures accountability. Instruct personnel in the proper performance of their duties.

  • Monitors developments/incidents related to police service procedures, techniques and equipment; makes recommendations for improvement to policies and procedures.

  • Responds to all calls involving serious incidents, unforeseen or unexpected events and serves as liaison with outside law enforcement and regulatory agencies.

  • Represents the Howard University Department of Public Safety in meetings with other law enforcement agencies, professional, business and community organizations, Howard University Faculty and Staff and the public.

  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned by appropriate authority.



Core Competencies



  • Knowledge of criminal law, including elements of offenses, rules of evidence, laws of arrest, search and seizures, methods of law enforcement, maintenance of public security, peace and safety etc.

  • Knowledge of current department, municipal and governmental policy and procedural changes relating to security or other public safety organizations that affect criminal investigative activities.

  • Knowledge of personal computer with some knowledge of accompanying word processing, spreadsheet, database and presentation software.

  • Skill in the use of firearms and other standard police equipment with the ability to secure a Special Police Commission with firearm authorization for the District of Columbia.

  • Skill in the use of both oral and written English with the ability to read technical literature, write administrative reports and to express complex cases and relationships verbally.

  • Excellent skill in public and customer relations with the ability to use tact, diplomacy and decorum when responding to student inquiries and community complaints.

  • Ability to participate in the investigation of crimes or incidents and present evidence in court if necessary.

  • Ability to remain emotionally stable and to display mature judgment and tact in explosive and/or dangerous situations.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule to include evenings, nights, weekends and/or holidays with days off as assigned.

  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with students, staff, faculty, medical staff, patients, other public safety organizations of the University, Hospital and the general public.



Minimum Requirements


High School Graduate or General Equivalency Diploma (GED); and Five (5) years of responsible work experience in law enforcement or security work which included two (2) years at a supervisory level or two (2) years of training in an accredited college or university in criminal justice or related field, or the equivalent combination of five (5) years combined relevant training and experience. Must pass a written examination and complete an Assessment Phase of the employment process. Candidates without formal First-Line or Mid-level Supervisory Law enforcement training, will be required to take the First-Line Supervisory Course offered by the Campus Public Safety Institute of the Consortium of Universities for the Washington Metropolitan Area.

title: Engineering Manager (Front-End/ Full Stack) (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
description:
Engineering Manager (Front-End/ Full Stack) (Bangkok based, relocation provided)

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager (Front-End/ Full Stack) (Bangkok based, relocation provided) role at Agoda.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

The Front-End Department

The Front-End Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end-to-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.

The Opportunity

We are looking hands-ons Development Managers who have unique knowledge and abilities to contribute to our highly scaled web products and mobile applications. You must be a strong leader who can guide our staff beyond our already high standards of engineering to the next level. The manager roles at Agoda are some of the most significant and challenging roles at the company. The right candidate is both extremely hands on – technically excellent, with solid engineering principles – and exhibits strong leadership and people development skills. We are looking for world class managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Maintain ownership and responsibility of mission critical systems.
  • Guide one or more Agile teams to success.
  • Get involved with full stack, server, and mobile app engineering and guide server, client, and infrastructure technical staff to the best solutions.
  • Directly manage between 5 and 10 technology professionals and be responsible for their performance at the company.

What you’ll Need to Succeed

  • At least 3 years of experience managing engineering teams of 3 people and more, 5+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Proficient with web client-side technologies (React, Redux, state management, JavaScript, SASS, Performance optimization)
  • Proficient in one or more mobile platforms (iOS, Android, Web)
  • Extremely proficient in at least one programming language (JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#)
  • Knowledge in scale, microservices and clean architecture
  • Extremely proficient in modern mobile and server coding and design practices, e.g., SOLID principles and TDD
  • Excellent people management and communication skills
  • B.S. in Computer Science or quantitative field; M.S. preferred

It is Great if you have

  • Deep experience in multiple platforms including Web, iOS, Android and API services
  • Have managed teams and been a key player at an Internet company that is at scale with large numbers of users and transactions per second
  • Have experience managing in a data driven company with experience analyzing and working with Big Data
  • Created new teams and greenfield projects solving large system problems
  • Previously worked with VP or Senior leadership at a large company
  • Worked on global projects serving world markets with distributed data centers and localization of the front end and data

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

title: Página da Vaga | Coordenador(a) de Suporte Técnico
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Missão do cargo

Coordenar a equipe responsável por prover apoio técnico às unidades de produção, com equipe especializada, promovendo segurança e eficiência das operações. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento da equipe e o desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o suporte técnico de segundo nível para equipamentos dinâmicos, sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação , realizando diagnósticos e troubleshooting em falhas complexas, embarcando esporadicamente para atendimento emergencial offshore e mantendo contato próximo com operações para alinhamento técnico contínuo.
  • Planejar e acompanhar ações corretivas e alternativas técnicas para falhas funcionais , atuando junto às equipes onshore e offshore, propondo soluções técnicas viáveis e apoiando na elaboração de planos de ação e priorização de recursos.
  • Atender chamados técnicos via Flow e Greendocs , analisando criticidade e urgência dos chamados, direcionando para resolução técnica adequada, registrando histórico e ações tomadas.
  • Participar de projetos nas fases FEL-1 , contribuindo com estimativas de custo e escopo técnico no EVTE e validando viabilidade de execução e integração com sistemas existentes.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área em situações críticas e emergenciais , participando de salas de guerra e interdições, elaborando respostas técnicas para órgãos reguladores e coordenando ações imediatas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar tecnicamente contratos e fornecedores , desenvolvendo memoriais descritivos (MD), acompanhando entregas pontuais e conformidade técnica, avaliando desempenho e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e revisar TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation) de grandes equipamentos , definindo critérios técnicos de avaliação, comparando propostas de fornecedores, recomendando alternativas mais adequadas ao escopo do projeto.
  • Avaliar e implantar recomendações de segurança e mudanças técnicas , participando da gestão de mudanças, propondo execução de melhorias, garantindo conformidade com normas e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Manter a governança técnica de sistemas de dados offshore , gerenciando o PI System e demais sistemas de monitoramento, garantindo integridade e disponibilidade das informações, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar a governança de turbomáquinas , monitorando desempenho e confiabilidade operacional, garantindo disponibilidade dos ativos críticos, desenvolvendo padrões técnicos e estratégias de manutenção mais eficazes, propondo ações de melhoria, garantindo suporte técnico especializado.
  • Gerenciar OT (Operational Technology) , avaliando redes industriais e obsolescência, implementando medidas de segurança cibernética, garantindo integridade dos sistemas de automação.
  • Assegurar a integridade e conformidade legal dos sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações , realizando o licenciamento junto à ANATEL e CINDACTA, conduzindo inspeções de abrangência de sinal VHF/UHF e antenas, executando inspeções de abrangência sonora do sistema PAGA.

Formação acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas)
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas técnicas ou de gestão será considerado um diferencial

Experiência prévia desejada

  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting de falhas complexas em:
  • Equipamentos dinâmicos (ex.: turbomáquinas)
  • Sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento como PI System
  • Familiaridade com redes industriais e tecnologia operacional (OT)
  • Gestão de contratos técnicos e fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation)
  • Licenciamento e conformidade legal de sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações (ANATEL, CINDACTA)
  • Normas e diretrizes de segurança operacional
  • Inglês avançado

Processo seletivo

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Ambiente de trabalho

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Executive Director of Strategic Transactions
description:
Overview

This executive leadership position is responsible for leading and directing complex real estate transactions from beginning to end for the capital asset portfolio. The incumbent will have oversight of a diverse portfolio and will work with the University and external partners to drive key objectives and optimize financial and mission-oriented performance of real estate transactions.

Must be able to organize and prioritize multiple tasks, effectively manage through stressful situations, and consistently make effective, high-quality decisions. Must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, service responsiveness and effectively manages business, regulatory agency, and internal and external relationships. This position will have overall responsibility for executing real estate transactions in conformity with the University’s strategic plan and with the approved Campus Master Plan.

Responsibilities

  • Formulates and executes strategies for long-range needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets. Source and identify real estate direct investment opportunities and joint venture/equity partners, and negotiate Letters of Intent and Term Sheets.
  • Coordinate pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third-party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Execute on the University’s strategic plan and initiatives approved by Senior Administration and Board of Trustees.
  • Prepare and present transaction analysis to Senior Administration and Board of Trustee regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc. Obtain all required Board of Trustee approvals and resolutions for real estate transaction.
  • Leads negotiations with investors and creditors, development partners, contractors, and vendors, ensuring that University policies are followed.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with University strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.
  • Prepare, direct, and negotiate purchase agreements, partnership agreements, lease agreements, and other legal transaction documents needed to close transactions.
  • Maintain copies of all University deeds, leases, and other real estate documents in a central database to allow management to respond to inquiries associated with real estate.
  • Act as coordinator and liaison to the University legal, risk management, environmental, health and safety departments for all real estate related activities.
  • Cultivate relationships with Community Associations, District Government agencies, and neighborhood groups to foster positive working relationships.
  • Prepare RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Coordinates with the Chief Financial Officer or designated committee regarding the evaluation, acceptance, management, and disposition of real property assets that are donated or bequeathed to the University.
  • Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.
  • Oversees development and review of periodic reports on finances and project performance to monitor the health of each project and the portfolio. Consults with Leadership in REDCAM, CFO, and Resident Life to prioritize work requirements.
  • Makes recommendations on processes, procedures, policies, methodologies, and metrics for managing, reviewing, measuring, and evaluating project and portfolio performance.
  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Core Competencies

  • Comprehensive knowledge of real estate markets and trends.
  • Ability to conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions regionally and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University and local school officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop processes and procedures to successfully monitor and provide project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
  • Ability to establish and execute projects by establishing communication plans to identify initial needs or supplemental project resources.
  • Communicates with the University community, the public, and the media regarding planning, design, and construction issues is required; Management skills, particularly in decision-making, are required.
  • Gathers and thoroughly analyzes information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.
  • Independent, entrepreneurial, ability to create processes to accomplish and manage acquisitions.
  • Ability to manage multiple suppliers and strategic partner relationships.

Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000
