title: Health Coach
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Health Coach role at Inside Higher Ed .

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Function and Purpose

Basic Function : The purpose of this position is to evaluate and improve the health and wellness of clients. The position is responsible for the supervision of medical and clerical staff in collaboration with the Medical Director to maintain quality services and efficient operations.

Supervision

Responsible for orienting and training medical and clerical staff and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include medical faculty, Faculty Practice Plan staff, HU/HUH staff, third party payers. External contacts include executive alumni, vendors/contractors, and general public and external agencies.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Guide clients toward optimal health within the continuum of chronic disease to well-being.
  • Facilitate client’s behavior change using mindfulness skills and motivational interviewing.
  • Counsel clients to assess their overall health and determine long-term goals.
  • Help clients develop strategies for achieving goals.
  • Collaborate with provider to ensure that strategies align with overall treatment plans.
  • Conduct one-on-one health coaching sessions by providing client education and instruction as directed by the provider.
  • Coordinate medical referrals from provider to specialists for clients with chronic comorbidities.
  • Maintain referral log/referral tracking system and distribute to the appropriate provider.
  • Record patients' medical history, vital statistics, and information such as test results in medical records.
  • Retrieve lab reports, dictations, and files and maintain orderly records.
  • Prepare treatment rooms for patient examinations, keeping the rooms neat and clean.
  • Authorize drug refills and provide prescription information to pharmacies.
  • Clean and sterilize instruments and dispose of contaminated supplies.
  • Prepare and administer immunizations and medications as directed by a provider.

Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). A função envolve prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico, em um espaço colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que de uma grande empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega; trabalhar em turnos variados, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança na área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.

  • Monitorar o andamento das rotas, identificar desvios e ajustar com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Conduzir reuniões, atribuir funções e trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia e melhoria do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Focar em métricas e identificar causas raízes para impulsionar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas para problemas complexos sem comprometer a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento/implementação de sistemas e processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações diárias; garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas e coordenar reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e na Amazon, conforme necessário.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Capacidade de liderar e treinar equipes; foco em resultados e KPIs.
  • Disposição para trabalhar em turnos 24-7, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Habilidade para prosperar em um ambiente rápido, ambíguo e colaborativo.
  • Engajamento com melhoria contínua, análise de métricas e resolução de problemas.
  • Uso de ferramentas de software e hardware para operações diárias;
  • Comunicação eficaz e capacidade de reportar status e questões a várias áreas.

Notas legais e Inclusão

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Basic Function

The Coordinator of Research & Data Management will be working closely with the Executive Director, to oversee all internal data and collection of data, oversee record system for UCS, organize collection of data and generate reports in collaborations with Exec. Dir. This position is intended to also drive research as an added component to the operations of UCS. The incumbent will conduct intakes and see walk ins for crisis intervention and short-term interventions. Additionally, the Coordinator will assist in the development of the testing program related to administration of assessments for learning disabilities.

Supervisory Accountability

Intermediate

Nature And Scope

Interacts with deans, directors, faculty, administration, and students.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide counseling and diagnostic services to clients in emotional distress, and those with adjustment, career choice and other developmental concerns.
  • Familiarity and experience with telehealth platforms.
  • Activities are a hybrid of online and in-person services.
  • This position requires 20 hours per week with the possibility of some evening hours.
  • Ability to and experience in providing predominantly short-term therapy services
  • Provides crisis intervention to clients who may be in crisis such as being suicidal or danger to self or others
  • Determines when psychiatric referrals should be made
  • Responsible for screening and interviewing of intake and “same-day” clients and presenting a concise description of the presenting problems to staff for disposition
  • Performs outreach services involving workshops, presentations and psychoeducational information
  • Competence providing services with cultural humility and sensitivity and demonstrated ability and commitment to the mission of social justice
  • Organizes and prepares detailed psychological reports, case histories and treatment plans
  • Teaches in-service course(s) for trainees and staff
  • Provides training and supervision to trainees
  • Participates in in-service training programs, supervision, workshops, and case conferences
  • Lead all data collection of UCS activities and generate in reporting formats as needed
  • Provide training, technical support and consultation for staff in the use of the Electronic Health Records system.

Core Competencies

  • Ability to work with college students with a range of presenting concerns including but not limited to cognitive, emotional, academic, and social distress, identity development, trauma, and behaviors of risk (e.g., suicidality)
  • Competence in both written and oral communication
  • Ability to promote, establish, and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with students, faculty, staff, university officials, parents of student and the general public
  • Ability to learn and operate current Electronic Health Record (EHR) system for documentation, supervision or other required data
  • Ability to work and carry out principal duties in-person and/or in a virtual environment
  • Familiarity and experience with telehealth platforms

Minimum Requirements

  • Doctoral Degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in clinical or counseling psychology
  • Minimum of two (2) years clinical experience, licensed or license eligible. If not yet licensed, then licensure must be within 2 years of the start date.

title: Clinical Research Nurse
description:
Overview


Join to apply for the Clinical Research Nurse role at Inside Higher Ed .


Benefits



  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture


Join Howard University and thrive with us!


Job Purpose



  • The Clinical Trials Nurse, under the guidance and supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI), ensures that the integrity and quality of clinical trials are maintained and conducted in accordance with federal, state, and local regulations, as well as ensures that Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals are obtained and Office of Regulatory Research Compliance (ORRC) policies and procedures are followed.


Supervisory Authority



  • None.


Nature and Scope



  • Effectively manages a demanding workload and provides excellent customer service skills to participants/families of the CRU, multi-disciplinary team members, practitioners, and the public.


Principal Accountabilities



  • Ensures that the clinical research site fully understands and complies with study protocol and provides training for site coordinators and/or supervision of site coordinators.

  • Functions as an expert research nurse and coordinates and manages the clinical trials program.

  • Provides direction in auditing and monitoring activities.

  • Collaborates with multidisciplinary researchers to establish research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials management.

  • Develops and conducts patient and family education.

  • Assists in identifying and writing research grants, publications in medical and nursing literature, study materials, brochures, and correspondence.

  • Conducts ongoing training of clinical trials staff, providing updated information on internal processes and resources and external benchmarks.

  • Actively participates in planning and evaluation processes to improve and advance clinical research within the organization, including recruitment strategies.

  • Leads task forces to address and resolve significant operational issues.

  • Along with the Principal Investigator/s, regularly functions as a preceptor or mentor.

  • On site provision of services.


Core Competencies



  • Responsible for providing quality registered nursing care to the participants in the CRU.

  • Assists the Principal Investigator (PI) with participant evaluation as detailed in the protocols submitted by the sponsor.

  • Communicates with sponsor as required in response to queries.

  • Excellent computer data entry and management skills.

  • Aids in participant care planning, assisting with and/or performing therapeutic/diagnostic procedures/tests according to protocol, reporting nursing observations/assessments, updating information in the patient’s electronic medical record, and other pertinent administrative needs.

  • Detailed trial assessments, participant care and ability to work amongst a diverse participant population.

  • Ability to maintain a harmonious working relationship with participants, colleagues, managers, and sponsors.

  • Must be proficient in blood draws, administration of injectable medications.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Minimum Requirements



  • Licensed as a Registered Nurse in the District of Columbia. Maintains active American Heart Association Basic Life Support certification, Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support, CNOR preferred.

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing preferred.

  • Four years of research nursing experience or two years of clinical nursing experience in a related specialty and two years of research nursing experience.

  • Certified Research Administrator (CRA) or Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Engineer, you will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients. In particular, you’ll be one of the key contributors in improving operational efficiency, building new features while capitalizing on standardized solutions. Working in close collaboration with both business and engineering teams within Carta, we navigate a unique and challenging product space that intersects with multiple domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and various other teams.

The Team You\'ll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

About You

You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • You have experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink (we invite you to check out our very own ink.carta.com)).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and are eager to explore how they can be applied to improve product experiences.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast but recognize when to build for the future.

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creatinginfrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional, and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross-functionallyto challenge the status quo, working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

Disclosures

  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.
  • For information on our data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.

Nós somos a Fadami Software & Innovation , líder em soluções para concessionárias de rodovias. Se você começou sua carreira como desenvolvedor(a), cresceu dominando arquitetura, performance e integrações de sistemas, e hoje atua como líder técnico(a) ou coordenador(a), essa vaga é para você. Buscamos alguém com uma mentalidade proativa, que tenha facilidade em aprender e dominar diferentes ferramentas e soluções, sempre buscando inovação e eficiência. Se você tem um perfil dinâmico, gosta de trabalhar em ambientes que exigem agilidade e adaptação constante, e é motivado por resultados, venha fazer parte de nossa equipe!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar técnica e estrategicamente equipes de produto e desenvolvimento, com foco em entregas consistentes, qualidade técnica e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Traduzir a estratégia do negócio em soluções tecnológicas robustas, garantindo a viabilidade técnica e a aderência ao roadmap da área;

  • Promover integração com stakeholders, facilitando a comunicação entre áreas técnicas e não técnicas;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Atuação atual ou recente em coordenação/liderança de equipes ou projetos na área de tecnologia ou produto digital;

  • Familiaridade com conceitos de DevOps, observabilidade e pipelines de CI/CD.

description:
Overview

Senior Piping Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

This position is for relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent expat role. Please note only referred candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Piping Specialist to join the Piping & Valve Group under Equipment Consulting Services Department (ECSD). ECSD provides Saudi Aramco and Joint Ventures with effective specialized engineering consultations and introduces viable technologies and maintains quality standards. As a Piping Specialist your primary role is to provide operation and project support, technical consultations and maintains standards on issues related to piping and pipelines.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Preform project review to evaluate standard compliance, design basis of Piping and Pipelines.
  • Support Operation related piping, and assessment of operation.
  • Conduct Fitness for services analysis of piping and piping components
  • Support in Standard Management for SAES, SAEP, SABP and 04-SAMSSs related to Piping and Pipelines
  • Determine the design pressure, design temperature, the material (allowable stress), and the diameter of the pipe.
  • Review and determine the maximum span of piping layout and the rating of different piping components (flange, fittings)
  • Perform review on free span and on-bottom analysis using the criteria used when analyzing Submarine Free Spans
  • Act as a technical advisor and provide timely operational support to Saudi Aramco’s organizations
  • Lead Technology evaluation of latest development in Piping systems.
  • Conduct and review Stress analysis and other special studies.
  • Review of Pipeline Integrity programs
  • Perform Plant assessment and witnessing of local manufacturing activities such as design, fabrication, assembly & testing of piping components.
  • Develop ideas for major technical studies or projects to be carried out by less senior engineers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor Degree in Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum of 20 years of experience in Oil and Gas
  • Experienced with initiating & review of BOM, PMS, ISS and SIS, PID and ISO.
  • Experienced with Piping Technical Specification, Hydrotest diagram, Hottapping calculations, & approval, technical bid evaluations, deviations assessment, code compliance.
  • Aware to the different types of piping materials, selection philosophy, and types of connections
  • Familiar with design codes related to piping and valves (ASME, ASTM, API, MSS-SP, AWWA, Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards etc.), allowable stresses required for the design case
  • Competent to read and review hydrotest diagrams, procedure and review of required code test values
  • Familiar with engineering design software such as Stress Analysis and FEA
  • Experienced with project phases, and review cycles of piping and valves, wall thickness calcs
  • Familiar with different types of materials properties & types of inspections (NDEs), including nonmetallic and elastomers

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development. We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
Join to apply for the Perinatal Sonographer-2 role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Perinatal Sonographer participates in the care of the patient, under the direct supervision of the Physician and in collaboration with the healthcare team by performing various fetal examinations, assisting in invasive procedures, reporting results of sonographic examinations, and ensuring patient safety and comfort during ultrasound procedures. The ideal candidate will specialize in high-risk obstetric imaging and be passionate about delivering exceptional prenatal care in a supportive and collaborative family focused environment alongside perinatologists and other healthcare professionals. This full-time position offers a 4-day work week to promote work-life balance without compromising patient care. Responsible for daily operations of the sonographic laboratory, equipment performance, and clinical sonographic quality assessment. Assumes responsibility and is accountable for adherence to Howard University FPP Privacy Policy policies and procedures, as well as all applicable federal and state laws as they pertain to healthcare and employment.

Supervisory Authority

None

Nature And Scope

  • Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered by the attending physician.
  • Acquire and analyze data obtained using ultrasound and related diagnostic technologies.
  • Meet examination components as defined by Maternal-Fetal Medicine Division, department procedures, established protocols, and AIUM’s examination guidelines.
  • Greet patients and guests, explain ultrasound procedures, prepare patients for appropriate examination according to department policies. Support patients and their families in a compassionate manner.
  • Verify accuracy of ultrasound requisition by checking physician’s orders in the patient’s medical record.
  • Interview patients to gather history pertinent to the ultrasound examination.
  • Use independent judgment and systematic problem-solving methods to produce high quality diagnostic information and optimize patient care.
  • Conduct fetal exams including 1st trimester ultrasound, nuchal translucency measurement, 2nd trimester basic and detailed anatomic survey, 3rd trimester ultrasound, limited examinations, follow up examinations, transvaginal examinations, and biophysical profiles.
  • Assist perinatologists in invasive procedures such as amniocentesis.
  • Provide summary findings to the physician to aid in patient diagnosis and management.
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive preliminary reports on the Viewpoint system.
  • Collaborate closely with maternal-fetal medicine physicians, genetic counselors, nurses, and referring providers to ensure comprehensive care.
  • Perform portable examinations as ordered.
  • Maintain equipment as instructed. Report equipment failures to the Lead Sonographer.
  • Perform daily pre-visit planning and assign related clerical duties as required.
  • Work in accordance with FPP and department policies regarding documentation and billing for ultrasound services.
  • Responsible for room preparation, stocking, clean-up, and equipment sterilization as needed.
  • Assume responsibility for the safety and well-being of all patients in the sonographic area/department. Monitor, observe and recognize any abnormal changes in patients’ conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies with adequate handoff as needed.
  • Obtaining assistance from physicians and other appropriate staff as needed.
  • Escort patients to an examination room, consultation room, or waiting area upon completion of the sonographic examination.
  • Coordinate with other staff to ensure appropriate patient care is provided.
  • Responsible for protecting Personal Health Information (PHI) and maintaining compliance with Howard University FPP Privacy Policy. Use the minimum PHI necessary when completing assignments.
  • Adhere to infection control, safety procedures, and HIPAA compliance.
  • Promote, establish, and maintain open and effective communication with all members of FPP. Serves as communication liaison between the physician and the patient.
  • Participate in continuing education and demonstrate critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Receive, organize, prioritize, store, and maintain transmittable information utilizing electronic technology.
  • Perform other duties as defined by management or physicians.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Clinical imaging responsibilities
  • Patient care and safety
  • Documentation and reporting
  • Interdisciplinary communication
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance
  • Professional development
  • Administrative support

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills to ensure maximum productivity and efficiency.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision while performing duties.

Minimum Requirements

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Require successful completion of an approved curriculum in diagnostic medical sonography or equivalent educational background.
  • Current registration (or Registry-eligible) by the American Registry of Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) in Obstetrics and Gynecology.
  • Prefer one-year prior OB experience or recent internship in obstetrics or MFM clinic. Associates degree preferred, new graduates welcome to apply.
  • Basic Life Support and CPR certification are preferred.
  • Nuchal translucency certification through NTQR or Fetal Maternal Foundation.
  • Ability to obtain within 6 months of employment is required if not currently certified.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

description:
Job description


A pessoa Product Owner será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantir alinhamento com a visão estratégica da empresa e mapear a jornada do cliente. Atuará como ponte entre stakeholders e o time de desenvolvimento, acompanhando sprints, validando entregas e tomando decisões ágeis para maximizar o valor entregue ao usuário.


Main responsibilities



  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, criando e mantendo uma lista clara e priorizada de funcionalidades, melhorias e correções que precisam ser desenvolvidas. A priorização deverá ser feita com base em critérios como valor de negócio, impacto no cliente, urgência e complexidade técnica.

  • Detalhar requisitos e funcionalidades sob a forma de histórias de usuário (user stories), fornecendo critérios de aceitação claros e compreensíveis para o time de desenvolvimento.

  • Garantir que o backlog esteja sempre refinado, constantemente atualizado com feedbacks do cliente e equipe, removendo itens obsoletos ou não mais relevantes.

  • Definir a visão do produto, articulada com as metas estratégicas da empresa e as necessidades do mercado.

  • Mapear a jornada do cliente, entendendo profundamente quem são os usuários, seus problemas e como o produto pode atender a essas necessidades ao longo da sua jornada.

  • Definir as entregas e marcos (milestones) ao longo do tempo, garantindo que haja uma estratégia clara de desenvolvimento e evolução do produto.

  • Negociar e alinhar as expectativas dos stakeholders internos e externos.

  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes: agir como o ponto central de comunicação entre os times técnicos, stakeholders e usuários, evitando mal-entendidos e desentendimentos.

  • Garantir que os objetivos das sprints sejam cumpridos, fornecendo feedback constante e eliminando possíveis impedimentos.

  • Avaliar cada incremento do produto desenvolvido pelo time, verificando se os critérios de aceitação foram cumpridos e se a entrega atende às expectativas do cliente e do mercado.

  • Ser ágil ao tomar decisões, tanto no que diz respeito a novas funcionalidades quanto à manutenção do escopo e à priorização de correções.

  • Balancear o que é tecnicamente possível com o que é economicamente viável, sempre levando em consideração o valor que será entregue ao usuário.


Requirements and skills



  • Experiência com gestão de backlog, priorização de funcionalidades e ciclo de vida do produto.

  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ágeis: Scrum, Kanban e outras metodologias ágeis.

  • Excel avançado.

  • Experiência em criação de histórias de usuário bem definidas, com critérios de aceitação claros e objetivos.

  • Experiência com negociação de prazos, funcionalidades e recursos, equilibrando as demandas do negócio com as limitações técnicas.


Additional information

  • Assistência Odontológica: Queremos você sempre feliz com um sorriso no rosto!

  • Licença parental: Somos uma empresa cidadã, e para honrar nosso compromisso, temos a licença parental estendida.

  • Wellhub (Gympass): Mantenha-se saudável com planos que podem abranger mais de 30 mil academias, estúdios e diversos outros benefícios da plataforma.

  • Gratuidades Bondinho: Muito além de um Parque! Duas gratuidades mensais pra você curtir a vista mais linda do Rio de Janeiro com quem você quiser. Este benefício é cumulativo para você levar a família toda ou amigos de uma vez só. Não é um máximo?!

Power Electronics Developer – TechnipFMC

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer

  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

Equal rights TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

title: Especialista de Segurança Cibernética
description:
Resumo

Cria, revisa e implementa políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação para garantir a proteção dos dados e o cumprimento de normas e regulamentos. Desenvolve diretrizes de segurança para o uso seguro de redes, sistemas e aplicações. Realiza análise de riscos de segurança, identificando ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos potenciais para a organização. Propõe e implementa controles de segurança que mitigam os riscos identificados. Realiza avaliações regulares de risco em novos sistemas, aplicativos e atualizações de software. Monitora constantemente os sistemas de TI para identificar atividades suspeitas ou não autorizadas. Implementa e monitora sistemas de detecção de intrusão (IDS) e sistemas de prevenção de intrusão (IPS). Lidera e coordena respostas a incidentes de segurança cibernética, como violações de dados, malware, ransomware e outros tipos de ataques. Investiga incidentes, identifica a causa raiz e recomenda ações corretivas. Cria relatórios pós-incidente e desenvolve estratégias de prevenção para evitar futuras ocorrências. Conduz avaliações regulares de vulnerabilidade e testes de penetração (pentesting) para identificar fraquezas nos sistemas. Gerencia e prioriza a correção de vulnerabilidades por meio da aplicação de patches e atualizações de segurança. Gerencia e monitora sistemas de controle de acesso, assegurando que os usuários tenham apenas os privilégios necessários para realizar suas funções. Implementa e administra soluções de autenticação multifator (MFA) e sistemas de gerenciamento de identidades. Participa do desenvolvimento, manutenção e exercícios do Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Plano de Recuperação de Desastres para garantir a continuidade das operações em caso de incidentes. Seleciona, especifica, configura e mantém ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança, como firewalls, antivírus, VPNs, sistemas de proteção de endpoints, DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e outros.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Design de Arquitetura de Segurança;
  • Experiência em Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes;
  • Experiência em Teste de intrusão;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança de Redes, Segurança de Aplicações e Segurança em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Criptografia, Gestão de Identidade e Acesso (IAM).

Formação

Superior Completo em Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

description:
Overview

gener8tor's turnkey platform for the creative economy connects startups, entrepreneurs, artists, investors, universities and corporations. The platform includes pre-accelerators, accelerators, corporate programming, conferences and fellowships focused on entrepreneurs, artists, musicians, startups and job seekers. This role is for a PR Specialist to elevate awareness of our programs and partnerships through storytelling, proactive media outreach, and account management. The PR Specialist will handle a high volume of requests, triage, prioritize, and execute PR deliverables that create measurable value for partner accounts and raise the profile of gener8tor programming.

Reporting to the VP of Business Development, the role will work closely with the Marketing team and collaborate with product line leaders to support programs including OnRamp Conference, gBETA Pre-Accelerators, gener8tor Investment Accelerators, Skills Accelerators, and Creative Music. The PR Specialist contributes to the overall communications strategy and ensures timely execution of PR initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Own PR intake and account management for partner accounts: triage requests from Partnerships/program leads/external partners, translate goals into PR briefs, set timelines and SLAs, and keep stakeholders updated.
  • Plan and execute account-specific PR campaigns that elevate gener8tor programming and deliver value for partner accounts (applications, attendance, thought leadership, brand lift).
  • Draft co-branded press materials (press releases, media advisories, pitches, talking points, bylines, case studies) aligned with gener8tor and partner brand guidelines.
  • Proactively pitch stories to media relevant to each partner's industry and program focus; secure coverage that drives program KPIs and expands partner visibility.
  • Coordinate media moments around program milestones to showcase partner collaboration and program success.
  • Maintain account-facing reporting (coverage, reach, message pull-through, backlinks, SOV) and translate results into actionable next steps for partners and program teams.
  • Build and maintain targeted media lists mapped to partner industries; cultivate reporter relationships on behalf of our accounts.
  • Package earned media for amplification (social, newsletters, web) in collaboration with Design/Social/Web teams.
  • Uphold partner approval workflows (legal/brand/PR) and maintain a clean CRM/PRM with account-level tracking, contacts, and follow-ups.
  • Support issues/crisis communications affecting partners or programs with clear escalation and pre-approved messaging.
  • Manage multiple projects and a high volume of asks while meeting SLAs and deadlines; continuously improve processes to deliver reliable value to accounts and raise the profile of gener8tor programming.

Requirements

  • Proficient English – Level C1–C2.
  • 2+ years in public relations, communications, or agency account work (startup, VC, tech, creative, or corporate-innovation experience a plus).
  • Demonstrated success placing stories and running PR campaigns; strong reporter and creator relationships preferred.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with clear, concise, on-brand messaging.
  • Proven account management capability: high-volume inbox management, prioritization, stakeholder communications, and on-time delivery.
  • Familiarity with PR tools (e.g., Cision, Muck Rack, Meltwater), project tools (e.g., Asana, Trello), CRM (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce), and Google Workspace.
  • Strong attention to detail; excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Partnerships, and program leads.
  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, PR, journalism, marketing, or related field (preferred).
  • Event support experience (press check-ins, on-site coordination, speaker prep) (a plus).
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter; commitment to equity across race, place, and gender.
  • A "no job is beneath me" mentality.

Cuidando de você, sempre! Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Nossa essência é carioca, com acolhimento genuíno e busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e seguimos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa. Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre buscando atendimento de excelência e soluções para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Overview

Mecânico de Manutenção - (Máquinas pesadas) – Descrição do papel: o Mecânico de Manutenção de Equipamentos Pesados será um profissional chave na equipe, responsável por assegurar a plena operacionalidade e segurança de uma vasta gama de máquinas. Este profissional realizará diagnósticos e reparos em sistemas elétricos, de refrigeração e mecânica hidráulica, atuando na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de Guindastes LIEBHERR e FUWA, Empilhadeiras HYUNDAI e HYSTER, e equipamentos da Linha Amarela, incluindo máquinas Volvo e Caterpillar. Será essencial a leitura e interpretação de diagramas para identificação e resolução de falhas, bem como a substituição precisa de peças e componentes. O(a) Mecânico(a) deverá assegurar a conformidade das manutenções com as normas de segurança (como NBR 15965), gerenciar e priorizar tarefas sob prazos, lidar dinamicamente com múltiplas demandas, aplicar senso crítico e de urgência na resolução de problemas e manter atenção rigorosa aos detalhes em todas as etapas, além de preencher relatórios de serviço e registros de manutenção de forma precisa e organizada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e defeitos mecânicos em sistemas diversos.
  • Fazer ajustes e regulagens em componentes mecânicos.
  • Monitorar o funcionamento de máquinas, identificando a necessidade de reparos.
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades de manutenção realizadas.
  • Colaborar na montagem e desmonte de equipamentos, conforme necessário.
  • Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos.
  • Acompanhar a manutenção de registros e documentação técnica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Amplo conhecimento em elétrica para manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de refrigeração.
  • Conhecimento Mecânico Hidráulico.
  • Leitura de diagramas e identificação de falhas.
  • Conhecimento em Empilhadeiras e Guindastes (incluindo modelos LIEBHERR, FUWA, HYUNDAI, HYSTER).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em manutenção de equipamentos da Linha Amarela (Volvo e Caterpillar).
  • Conhecimento da norma NBR 15965 (conforme relevância para o escopo da empresa).

Área responsável pelas atividades centrais de planejamento de demanda e pela sua execução para uma Unidade de Negócio e região. Responsável pela parametrização das variáveis que impactam a demanda no sistema.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Responsável pela execução do planejamento de demanda por cliente, incluindo as atividades do S&OP, como: coleta e execução de prioridades da BU, geração de previsões estatísticas, identificação de sinais de demanda, gestão de desvios e resolução de problemas;
  • Realiza análises e relatórios de resultados do forecast (consumo, alertas de tendência gerados pelo sistema, acurácia e viés da previsão, análise de causas de erro) e faz ajustes ou ações corretivas para eliminar desvios;
  • Utiliza técnicas estatísticas (como séries temporais, regressão linear, entre outras) para construir planos de demanda base, sem restrições. Conduz análises de portfólio sob a perspectiva do planejamento, recomendando otimizações e racionalização de SKUs;
  • Responsável pelos indicadores de performance da demanda, como acurácia da previsão (MAPE), viés, variabilidade da demanda, assertividade de promoções, entre outros, seguindo os padrões da empresa;
  • Responsável pela coleta e correto uso dos parâmetros necessários para realizar o planejamento de demanda adequado (logística, fornecedores, itens).

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Forte experiência e proficiência em planejamento de demanda e análise de portfólio aplicados à cadeia de suprimentos, com foco no setor-alvo;
  • Alta capacidade analítica e quantitativa, com habilidade para interpretar e gerenciar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística de previsões e elaboração de orçamentos de vendas (sales budgeting).

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento no Sistema Relex.

  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Nossa cultura

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. The Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients, collaborating with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management and Fund administration.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. You will be one of the key contributors improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions in a challenging product area.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade features for the Unified Experience for PE.
  • Build and shape front-end and/or full-stack solutions using ReactJS, TypeScript, and related tooling.
  • Champion scalable architectures, SOA/microservices concepts, and data-driven approaches to improve user experience for Private Equity clients.
  • Engage with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing to deliver customer value and refine requirements.

About You

  • You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:
  • 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • Experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • Passion for elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, TypeScript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • Interest in AI/ML technologies and how they can improve product experiences.
  • A desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to own your work end-to-end.
  • Willingness to move fast while building for the future.

Disclosures

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

title: Creative Producer - Web Summit Rio de Janeiro
description:
About Web Summit

How did Web Summit become, in the words of Forbes, the best tech conference on the planet? Meaningful connections. Our tech events are unmissable because we make it easier for the right people to meet and connect. Everyone at Web Summit works towards this goal. And we’re just getting started. We’re always looking to build on the impact we have already made at Web Summit. In the coming years we’ll take Web Summit to new markets, promoting global connectivity, highlighting important issues and connecting global leaders – all while making a positive impact on the environment and communities we encounter. To build a better company, we have to better ourselves. We do that by finding the most ambitious people to work with us.

The role

We’re looking for a Creative Producer to join our growing Content Team for Web Summit Rio . You’ll be responsible for curating, shaping, and delivering high-calibre on-stage content. From speaker booking to on-site production, this is a fast-paced, high-impact role where editorial meets execution.

What you will do

  • Industry Research: Track trends, identify leading voices, and stay ahead of emerging startups and technologies across relevant industries.
  • Speaker Booking: Secure high-profile and A-list speakers, especially for our Centre Stage. You’ll lead outreach, negotiations, and coordination with speakers and their teams.
  • Editorial Ownership: Shape the narrative of our stages. Work with speakers to define compelling topics, formats, and titles. Write talk descriptions, moderator briefs, and technical scripts.
  • Live Production: Manage speaker logistics and live rehearsals. Ensure all assets are prepped and stages run smoothly on-site, collaborating with technical and production teams.
  • Platform & Data Management: Maintain accurate records using our internal platforms and tools. Attention to detail and flawless admin are essential to your success.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with speakers, companies, and stakeholders before, during, and after the event.
  • Internal Expertise: Be a source of insight and strategic advice for internal teams. You’ll act as the go-to expert for your speaker tracks and industries.

Skills and abilities we\'re looking for

  • You’re consistently booking high-quality, relevant speakers for Centre Stage and beyond.
  • You aim to confirm at least 4 A-list speakers per year across your content verticals.
  • You stay ahead of industry shifts and consistently maintain a strong research pipeline with timely, strategic outreach.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively with your manager, particularly around pipeline challenges.
  • You demonstrate strong editorial judgment , creating engaging formats and talk titles that resonate with our global audience.
  • You are a reliable team player who collaborates effectively across departments.
  • Your admin and data tracking are consistently up-to-date and accurate, supporting seamless internal operations.

Who you are

  • Ideally, 2–4 years of experience in production, content, editorial, or events (or adjacent industries)
  • Strong interest in tech, innovation, entrepreneurship, or media
  • Confident communicator with experience engaging high-profile individuals and companies
  • Exceptional organisational and writing skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with tools like CRMs, Google Suite, and other productivity platforms is a plus

Benefits and perks

  • Hybrid-working model open to all employees.
  • Fully subsidised healthcare, dental, employee assistance programme (EAP) and more.
  • Pension contribution up to 6% (Irish based only).
  • A dedicated in-house L&D department, with access to workshops, online learning and resources to help you excel in your career development.
  • Company laptop, generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements.
  • Our very own Tramway Team, which drives community and morale-boosting events for employees to participate in.
  • Annual company get-togethers, charity days, and monthly wellbeing talks.
  • Wellness subsidy issued to all employees of €1000 per year

At Web Summit, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We want talent from all walks of life to help us on our journey to digitise the conference sector. Hiring decisions are made purely on experience, skills and the needs of the business.

Overview

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Experiência com Compras e negociações;
  • Pacote Office Avançado;

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de 15.000 lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

Além disso, nossos canais digitais ampliam nossa atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além dos medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.

Em 2014, criamos a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e na distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo um serviço especializado e eficiente. Para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição, estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

O que nos torna únicos? Nossa essência carioca, o acolhimento genuíno e a busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e ganhamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importante.

A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Statkraft has 3500 employees in 15 countries.


The main activities of the Business Area Market Operations & IT are energy management for Statkraft’s assets, trading & origination and market access services in Europe, South America and India. In addition, the business area contains local business support, finance & risk support, and IT services. In M there are 750 employees. The market operations of Statkraft are performed in the offices of Amsterdam, Düsseldorf, Stockholm, Istanbul, London, New Delhi, Oslo, Rio de Janeiro and Trondheim.


Your team:


The Finance and Risk operations of Statkraft Markets Brazil is performed in Rio de Janeiro and Florianapolis. This role will be located in Rio de Janeiro.



  • Extremely qualified professionals with excellent knowledge and careers in energy and financial markets

  • Offices located in Rio de Janeiro and in Florianópolis focused on:

  • Power Trading and Origination

  • Business Development and Structuring


Your role as Senior Risk Analyst


Responsible for developing, controlling and reporting Profit / Loss (P / L), market and credit risk metrics, risk methodologies and mitigation strategies. Provide support and guidance to help front office structure their activities towards market and credit risk. Analyze new products and structures. Ensure that all operations are carried out within the established risk limits and that business results are reported accurately.


Main Activities



  • Develop, operate and maintain risk models for Trading & Origination;

  • Monitor and report risk metrics and risk capital allocation/usage of the trading books, ensuring that the total amounts are within the mandates;

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience

Company overview: Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through software for venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform supports 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries and provides tools to build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with solutions designed to enhance the impact of fund CFOs. Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure and creating an end-to-end ERP platform for private markets.

For more information about offices and culture, visit the Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

As a Senior Engineer, you will help build and shape our product for Private Equity clients. You will contribute to improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions. You will collaborate with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and related areas.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team creates a unified, user-friendly experience for investors, including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Key problem areas:

  • Fragmented experience: lack of unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, hindering portfolio overviews.
  • Missing valuations and insights: valuations, holdings, financials, and KPIs are not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers.
  • Cumbersome entry to key products: no streamlined access to essential tools from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected platform workflows: data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting are not well integrated, impacting product launches and analytics.

About You

You care deeply about users and build enterprise-grade applications. You work well acrossSolver and Tech Lead archetypes and can transition between hands-on work and leadership. You should meet the following expectations:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • You have experience architecting complex SaaS products with SOA and microservices.
  • You are passionate about elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and applying them to improve product experiences.
  • You aspire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You value communication as a strength and want to own your work end-to-end.
  • You are able to move fast while recognizing when to build for the future.

description:
Sobre a Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. Nossa cultura celebra pensadores independentes e realizadores que impactam positivamente nossos clientes e moldam nossa indústria. A Equipe

A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de logística, mineração, energia e O&G. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Como você irá contribuir

  • Liderar a execução de frentes de trabalho com propriedade, identificando iniciativas de melhoria, desempenhando papel ativo em todos os aspectos de envolvimento com o cliente;

  • Responder prontamente às demandas do projeto e antecipar ações críticas para o sucesso das iniciativas;

  • Viabilizar articulações efetivas entre lideranças, conquistando alinhamentos e produzindo resultados que atendem aos interesses dos envolvidos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da prática apoiando o desenvolvimento de produto e/ou indústria;
  • Desenvolver a conta que estiver atuando, identificando oportunidades e trabalhando em conjunto com a liderança para transformar em negócios;
  • Ser elo de conexão entre staff e liderança para disseminação de cultura e gestão de questões;
  • Coordenar e garantir adequações às questões administrativas (programação, planilha de vendas, collections, etc.).

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos complexos em ambiente multicultural e corporativo nos setores de mineração e Óleo & Gás, seja em consultorias ou indústrias;
  • Pós-graduação em gestão de projetos e/ou administração ou finanças será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento robusto dos produtos de I&CP;
  • Ao menos uma certificação em gestão de projetos de entidades preconizadas (ex: AACE, PMI, etc);
  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Inglês avançado.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu eu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A&M. Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Why Join Elfie

We’re a global start-up that is mission-led and fiercely product-driven. We’re building something that improves lives with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

Job Description - Coordenador BIM (RIO00DP)

Construindo sobre nosso passado. Prontos para o futuro

A Worley é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais composta por especialistas em energia, produtos químicos e recursos. Estabelecemos parcerias com clientes para entregar projetos e criar valor ao longo da vida de seus ativos. Estamos a unir dois mundos, avançando em direção a fontes de energia mais sustentáveis, ao mesmo tempo que ajudamos a fornecer a energia, os produtos químicos e os recursos necessários agora.

Procuramos um Coordenador(a) BIM para liderar a implementação, gestão e padronização de processos BIM em projetos de engenharia Onshore, assegurando conformidade com normas e integração com sistemas corporativos e dos clientes. O profissional será responsável por coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, gerir o fluxo de informações do projeto e garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas de Building Information Modeling para otimizar a qualidade e a eficiência na entrega dos empreendimentos.

Responsibilities

  • Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar a execução da estratégia BIM em todas as fases do projeto.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas, padrões corporativos e diretrizes como ISO 19650 .
  • Definir e implementar o BEP (BIM Execution Plan) e outros documentos de gestão BIM.
  • Coordenar a integração entre modelos BIM de diferentes disciplinas (arquitetura, estrutura, instalações, processos industriais, etc.).
  • Validar modelos digitais, assegurando consistência, integridade e qualidade das informações.
  • Promover integração entre plataformas BIM e sistemas corporativos (COMOS, AVEVA, Revit, Navisworks, entre outros).
  • Gerenciar revisões e controle de versões dos modelos digitais.
  • Treinar e dar suporte às equipes de projeto quanto às metodologias, ferramentas e fluxos BIM.
  • Apoiar clientes e stakeholders na interpretação e uso de informações geradas em ambiente BIM.
  • Participar ativamente na análise e proposição de melhorias nos processos digitais da companhia.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação de projetos BIM em indústrias de grande porte (óleo & gás, energia, mineração, infraestrutura).
  • Experiência com gestão de modelos multidisciplinares e detecção de interferências (Clash Detection).
  • Conhecimento de normas e padrões BIM nacionais e internacionais (incluindo ISO 19650).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e comunicação com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com integração BIM em plataformas de gestão documental (Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint).
  • Conhecimento em programação visual (Dynamo, Grasshopper) e/ou linguagens de script aplicadas ao BIM.
  • Certificações em BIM Management.
  • Espanhol técnico.

Competências Comportamentais
